description: Validation performance appears excellent but collapses under deployment-like conditions.
safe_response: Hold deployment and investigate validation boundary.

description: Hidden target-related information is introduced into a feature and must be exposed.
safe_response: Reject the suspicious feature and retrain.

description: Training and validation splits violate temporal or group structure.
Simulation performance does not transfer to representative operating conditions.
safe_response: Enter degraded/safe mode and require representative validation.

description: Optimization improves nominal performance while increasing worst-case risk.
safe_response: Reject the optimization and retain the safer configuration.
